heroSubtext: From a small team in Brazil to a multi-title publishing platform — this is our story, and the people building it.

timeline.title: Founded Axion Games in Brazil
timeline.description: Axion Games was founded in Brazil, where the studio's game-development journey began.

timeline.title: Founded 2Axion Games in California
timeline.description: The studio expanded into the US market with the founding of 2Axion Games in California.

timeline.title: Launched Triggerun
timeline.description: Triggerun shipped to players — one of the studio's earliest released titles.

timeline.title: Launched The Killbox
timeline.description: The Killbox launched, growing the studio's catalog of fast-paced action titles.

timeline.title: Developed Project Suponic
timeline.description: Work began on Project Suponic, pushing the studio's development capabilities further.

timeline.title: Launched Rage Wars
timeline.description: Rage Wars launched, expanding the studio's competitive multiplayer lineup.

timeline.title: Technical Service for Steven Universe: Tap Tap
timeline.description: The studio provided technical services for Steven Universe: Tap Tap, partnering on a major licensed IP.

timeline.title: Developed Edge Survival
timeline.description: Edge Survival entered development — now featured in the MULTIVERSE game library.

timeline.title: MULTIVERSE is Born
timeline.description: MULTIVERSE launched, bringing the studio's full catalog together under one publishing platform.

ctaBody: Join our community of innovators and receive the latest updates on the MULTIVERSE ecosystem directly in your inbox.
